entities.title: qwen-chat sources
entities.summary: All of qwen-chat's Rust modules, flat: the command line and chat loop, the Qwen3.5 prompt format, the llama.cpp engine and the weights download.
entities.purpose: main.rs parses the command line, runs the interactive loop or a one-shot question and handles Ctrl-C; prompt.rs builds ChatML text and splits replies at </think>; engine.rs wraps llama.cpp (context, batches, sampler); download.rs finds or fetches the pinned GGUF file and verifies it.
boundaries: Only engine.rs talks to llama.cpp, and only download.rs uses the network.
The conversation is kept in one append-only context; when a message no longer fits, the context is rebuilt from the system message and the most recent exchanges, without their reasoning.
prompt.rs and the UTF-8 and path helpers are pure and unit-tested; running the real model is checked by hand (see the README).
